title: Grid Penalty
statement:
Cars start the race in a line called the **grid**: first place at the front.

One driver broke a rule and gets a **k-place penalty**: they move `k` places back, and every driver they pass moves one place forward. A driver can never go further back than the last place.

Print the new grid.
input_format:
Line 1: the driver codes in grid order, separated by spaces.
Line 2: the code of the penalised driver and `k`.
output_format: The new grid on one line, codes separated by spaces.

examples.input:
VER NOR LEC HAM PIA
NOR 2
examples.explanation: NOR drops from 2nd to 4th. LEC and HAM each move up one place.

examples.input:
VER NOR LEC HAM PIA
LEC 10
examples.explanation: LEC can only drop to last place.
